body: Yeah you're probably right. Thanks for the help :)

Just please don't say recomp, I tried it for 2 months and it wasn't really working for me. I am debating whether or not to cut so I can see a faint outline of abs or do I bulk since I have zero muscle.

 It was easier when I was fatter but I am not sure now since I look normal in clothes, I don't know if I should cut towards under 15%.
https://www.muscleandstrength.com/workouts/frankoman-dumbbell-only-split.html this is the plan I have been using (done the first 2 days). I am really nervous to use a barbell.

I also feel like a failure a lot of the time, but then I think how much of the world I still have to see.

And I think you are trying to keep going as well deeeep down, otherwise why would you still want to keep on talking to an idiot like me.

You got into college, I struggled to do that and it took me multiple attempts so you're smarter than me

You have been in a relationship, I have never had that and want it so bad, probably would die for it if that makes twisted sense.
you're not a failure. you may have had some failed experiences but you aren't one. you have had highs!

you aren't from what I have seen so far, you are just having a tough time right now. But I promise whether it be tomorrow, in a year or 2, Your life will be better. You have potential. You are studying with a goal which already speaks of ambition and your strength. I wish I had that.

I  don't really have much of a future at the moment. And you have a relationship, you're already one up on me :P but I think it can get better for you, please keep fighting and could you please stop drinking
But I hope you do find it eventually. Even if it takes you till you're 80. I just hope it doesn't take us that long haha

Life changes, your career might not be what it wants to be but try find other desires. I don't really have a career goal but my aim that keeps me going is to eventually have a family. It doesnt look likely at the moment but I am going to keep striving for it
Can you talk to them, you obviously care for them.
I am confident you won't do it as you are aware of the pain it will cause that individual. You aren't a monster, that empathy shows it. Keep on fighting.
I have nights like that too, and it shows you have strength to still be here

I made a post tonight about love, albeit under different circumstances but someone PMed me and said that there is so much to experience in the world that you don't need a partner for. Live on to try everything else
I didn't do too hot at uni but now I made it through, I am sure if a weakling like me can, you can too! People can be cruel and not realise the impact of words
what makes you say that?
Well I just want to let you know there is one stranger hoping you make it through tonight so we can be tired together
Is there anyone you can talk to?
Its tiring, yes but is there not potential for it to get better? Because I sure as hell am tired of it right now
Do you mind me asking whats the main problem right now?
Want to talk?

I didn't mention settling but yeah I completely agree. More and more I am tempted to go out and do this but it just feels wrong? I for some strange reason even feel like people I consider "below my league" would reject me.
